title: WA MCP Tool Response Envelope
description: Standard JSON envelope for FrankenTerm MCP tool responses. MCP tools return this structure inside the tool text payload with tool-specific data in the 'data' field on success and FT-MCP error codes on failure.

ok.description: Whether the MCP tool call succeeded. When true, 'data' contains the result. When false, 'error' and 'error_code' describe the failure.

data.description: Tool-specific response data. Present when ok=true. Type depends on the specific MCP tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present when ok=false.

error_code.description: Machine-readable MCP error code for programmatic handling. Present when ok=false. Format: 'FT-MCP-0001'.

hint.description: Actionable suggestion for resolving the error. Present when ok=false and a remediation is known.

elapsed_ms.description: Time taken to execute the tool call in milliseconds.

now.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the response was generated.

mcp_version.description: MCP envelope version emitted by the runtime.

error_codes.title: Standard MCP Tool Error Codes
error_codes.description: Well-known FT-MCP error codes returned by MCP tool envelopes
